assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production-ready 16-pose character animation atlas for an original browser fantasy RPG. Image 1 is the Mage identity reference. Preserve that exact character identity: young adult chibi Mage, short silver bob, blue eyes, oversized deep-violet crescent hat, ivory-and-violet long coat, brown boots, wooden staff with a faceted violet crystal. Image 2 is the approved Druid animation atlas and is ONLY the rendering, proportions, camera, spacing, and pose-language reference. Create exactly one Mage, repeated as EXACTLY 16 isolated full-body poses in a strict 4-column × 4-row atlas. Polished hand-painted mobile fantasy RPG rendering matching Image 2: crisp dark outline, soft warm shading, expressive but readable at 100px. Same character proportions, clothing details, palette, staff, right-facing three-quarter camera, and scale in every frame. Each pose centered in an equal square cell, feet aligned near 88% cell height, entire hat/staff/coat inside the middle 70% with generous empty gutters. Nothing may cross a cell boundary. Row 1 WALK: left-foot stride, passing pose, right-foot stride, passing pose with heel lifted. Row 2 STAFF ATTACK: low anticipation, forward drive, staff fully thrust right, upright recovery. Row 3 ARCANE CAST: gather power close to chest, raise staff, release with free hand extended, gentle recovery. Row 4 REACTIONS: hit recoil shielding face, neutral standing idle, defeated seated/exhausted with staff down, joyful victory with raised staff/fist. Critical output constraint: background must be genuinely transparent RGBA alpha. Do NOT depict transparency. No checkerboard, white, gray, black, or colored backdrop. No scenery, ground, cast shadows, text, labels, borders, gridlines, particles, projectiles, extra characters, creatures, or detached props. Preserve clean transparent gaps inside the silhouette, including around the hat, staff, arms, and coat. Square atlas.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target and its transparent 4×4 production animation atlas must remain structurally unchanged. Replace the Druid character in all sixteen cells with the SAME original classless Apprentice: approachable young adult, swept dark-brown hair without flowers, calm brown eyes, warm medium skin, simple cream trail tunic, sage trousers, brown cross-body strap and belt pouch, brown fingerless gloves and boots, one small worn dagger. Replace every staff action with an appropriate dagger or empty-hand trail action while preserving each frame's meaning and timing: row 1 walk; row 2 attack anticipation/drive/extension/recovery; row 3 breathe/guard/ready/recovery; row 4 hit/idle/defeated/victory. Remove leaf cloak, staff, crystal, hair flower, magic, and all Druid class details. Preserve exactly: square canvas dimensions, strict four columns × four rows, sixteen isolated poses, each pose's cell position, scale, foot anchor, right-facing three-quarter camera, wide gutters, hand-painted rendering style, outline and warm lighting. Keep the entire figure and dagger within its original cell. Keep Image 1's real transparent alpha unchanged everywhere outside the figures. Background pixels must remain alpha 0. Add no backdrop, pattern, checkerboard, floor, shadow, text, labels, gridlines, border, particles, projectile, creature, extra character, or detached prop. This is a character replacement within an existing transparent atlas, not a newly presented sprite-sheet mockup.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact Apprentice dagger 4×4 animation atlas and the character identity/layout reference. Create the matching BOW variant. Preserve the same Apprentice identity, brown swept hair, warm skin, cream tunic, sage trousers, leather strap/pouch/gloves/boots, hand-painted style, exact 4×4 structure, sixteen positions, proportions, scale, camera, lighting, frame spacing, and all reaction expressions. Replace the dagger in every frame with one simple weathered shortbow plus an arrow only when logically needed. No dagger remains anywhere. Keep frame meanings: Row 1: four-step walk with bow carried safely. Row 2: ranged attack—plant feet and nock arrow, draw bow, full release toward the right, lower bow/recover. Row 3: trail techniques—steady breath, defensive braced bow guard, careful rightward aim, relax. Row 4: hit recoil, neutral idle holding bow, defeated seated with bow down, happy victory raising fist while holding bow safely. Every bow limb, string, and arrow must remain entirely inside its own cell; nothing crosses cell boundaries. No loose detached weapons. Deliver a square atlas. No scenery, floor, shadow, text, label, UI, border, gridlines, spell particles, projectile already in flight, creature, or extra character. Keep a clean uniform neutral checker backdrop if the source editor cannot preserve real alpha; do not introduce any new background texture or color variation, because the runtime will remove that neutral backdrop.

rejected: Four earlier Apprentice generations painted rather than encoded transparency and were not bundled. Their generated originals remain in the generator output directory.
